underConstruction.title: Under construction
underConstruction.body: This part of the app is not ready yet.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Choose the language for menus and labels. Catalog items stay in the language they were written in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.setDisplayName: Set a display name in Account

account.title: Account
account.headline: Display name
account.body: There is no sign-in. The name lives on this phone, shows on the leaderboard, and starts over on a new phone.
account.nameSavedBody: The leaderboard will use this display name.

displayName.title: Pick a display name
displayName.body: The log, points, and badges stay with this name on this phone. There is no account. A new phone starts fresh.
displayName.label: Display name

dashboard.pickNameBody: Your points, contribution graph, and charts stay with this name on this phone. Set it in Account under Settings.
dashboard.splitEmpty: Log a reuse or disposal to see the split.
dashboard.categoriesEmpty: Categories show up after you log an item.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.previewNote: Cook ideas from the catalog. Tap one to open the item.
recipes.emptyBody: Share a cook idea from Submit and it shows up here right away.
recipes.lead: Cook ideas from the shared catalog. Open one to see steps on the item.

log.title: Your log
log.pickNameBody: The log and points stay with this name on this phone. Set it in Account under Settings. There is no sign-in, and a new phone starts fresh.
log.note: Counts only. No carbon estimate, and no weight saved.
log.emptyBody: Search for something you have, then record a reuse or a disposal. Ideas you share are counted above.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.bannerTitle: Friendly competition, not a verified ranking.
leaderboard.bannerBody: Display names are not tied to an account, so a name can be copied and points can be inflated.
leaderboard.divisionNote: {{label}} is a placeholder. Rankings stay by points, the same in every division for now.
leaderboard.rankUsesName: Your rank uses the display name stored on this phone.
leaderboard.setNameHint: Set a display name in Settings to see your rank.
leaderboard.emptyTitle: No one is on the board yet
leaderboard.emptyBody: Log a reuse or share an idea and your display name takes the first spot.

browse.title: Browse
browse.tagline: What do you have, and can it be reused?
browse.note: A shared catalog for households. No account.

results.title: Results
results.nothingBody: The catalog doesn’t have “{{q}}” yet. Add a reuse idea and it shows up in search right away.

category.title: Category
category.emptyBody: Submit an item and it will land here as soon as it is published.

item.title: Item
item.noIdeas: No reuse ideas yet. Use Submit to add one. It publishes right away.
item.disposeSection: Rather just get rid of it
item.generalPath: General path for {{category}}, because this item has no disposal of its own.
item.noDisposal: No disposal guidance for this item yet.
item.disclaimer: This is general guidance, not a map of local facilities. Rules differ by city, and Recycler does not ask where you live.

logAction.noIdeasHint: No reuse ideas yet. Submit one and it will show up here.
logAction.howDispose: How did you get rid of it?
logAction.trashHint: Bag it with household trash. Keep it out of recycling if it is dirty or not accepted where you live.

badges.title: Badges
badges.pickNameBody: Badges stay with the name on this phone. Set it in Account under Settings.
badges.note: Earned from reuses, disposals, and ideas you share. Not from carbon math.

submit.title: Submit
submit.nowhereBody: The catalog has no categories yet, so a new item has no shelf.
submit.pickNameBody: Ideas you share are credited to the name stored on this phone.
submit.successItem: {{item}} is in the catalog. You earned {{points}} points.
submit.choosePath: Pick a path. An item is a material in the catalog. A recipe is a reuse idea attached to an item.
submit.photoPermission: Allow photo access to attach a picture, or publish without one.
submit.photoReadFailed: That picture could not be read. Try a JPEG, PNG, or WebP under 1.5 MB.
submit.itemExistsHint: “{{name}}” already exists. Open Add recipe to attach an idea to it.
submit.createsItem: This creates a new item. 25 points.
submit.itemExistsError: That item already exists. Add a recipe to it instead.
submit.addItemBody: It publishes immediately as {{name}}. Add a photo of the material if you have one. Recipes come later from Add recipe.
submit.disposalPlaceholder: Optional. Short guidance for getting rid of it.
submit.pickOrCreate: Search and pick an existing item, or create one.
submit.disposalPlaceholderNew: Optional. Used only if this item is new.
submit.titlePlaceholder: What should this idea be called?
submit.materialsPlaceholder: One ingredient or tool per line
submit.addRecipeBody: It publishes immediately as {{name}}. Pick an existing item or create one, then describe the idea.
submit.noMatches: No matches. Create an item instead.
submit.itemExistsAttachHint: “{{name}}” already exists. Publishing will add an idea to it (15 points) and keep its current photo.
submit.pictureHint: Optional. JPEG, PNG, or WebP under 1.5 MB.

scan.title: Scan
scan.body: Scanning is not in this version. Search for the item instead.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Photos are not in this version. Describe the item in Search or Submit instead.

notFound.title: Missing page
notFound.emptyTitle: That page is not in the app
notFound.emptyBody: Head back to the catalog and search for what you have.

onboarding.lookUpBody: Search the catalog or pick a material. Recycler shows whether it can be reused, and a plain way to get rid of it if not.
onboarding.reuseFirstTitle: Reuse first, then let it go
onboarding.reuseFirstBody: Follow a cook, beauty, art, or useful idea. Disposal steps sit on the same page. Trash is the last stop, not the first.
onboarding.logActionsBody: Record each reuse or disposal. No account and no password. You’ll pick a display name next, and Recycler will keep it on this phone.
onboarding.keepGoingBody: Points and badges come from real actions, not carbon math. Recycler counts reuses, disposals, and ideas you share.

errors.apiUnreachable: Could not reach the Recycler API. Start the server and try again.
